name: spline
description: Build 3D scenes, websites and app screens in Spline, live in the Spline editor.

interface.longDescription:
Spline is a design platform for interactive 3D content. Ask for an 3d scene or object and it gets built in the Spline 3D editor, which opens beside the chat so you can watch it come together, edit it or iterate with it.

Build 3d presentations, 3d simulations, 3d configurators, 3d illustrations, 3d icons, and more. The scenes you build can be edited.

Create 3d landing pages and interactive experiences, and refine your 3d creations with direct manipulation using the 3d editor. Export your content to other formats, or deploy as URLs.

positive.description: Create a new 3D scene from a description
positive.prompt: Make a floating low-poly island with a palm tree in Spline
positive.expected_behavior: A new 3D file opens in the Spline panel and the island with a palm tree appears in it as the scene is built. The reply says the scene is in the Spline panel.

positive.description: Edit the scene made earlier in the same chat
positive.prompt: Make the water around the island a deeper blue and add a small wooden boat
positive.expected_behavior: The same file in the Spline panel changes: the water turns deeper blue and a boat appears. No new file is created.

positive.description: Look at the scene from another angle
positive.prompt: Show me the island from directly above
positive.expected_behavior: A top-down image of the island comes back in the chat, and the reply describes what it shows.

positive.description: Undo the last change to the scene
positive.prompt: Undo that, go back to how the island was before the boat
positive.expected_behavior: The file in the Spline panel goes back to the island before the last request: the boat and the deeper blue water are gone. The reply names the version it restored.

positive.prompt: Design a landing page for a specialty coffee brand in Spline
positive.expected_behavior: A new 2D file opens in the Spline panel with a landing page frame: hero, product section and call to action, in a consistent coffee-brand style.
The Spline dashboard opens in the panel, showing the connected account's files.

negative.prompt: Delete all of my Spline files

negative.prompt: Upgrade my Spline account to the Pro plan
